sections.name: study-773704369559-00-75050---Main.ldr
sections.description: Complete B-Wing starfighter assembled from its wing, fuselage, and engine submodels.
sections.visual_observation: Whole 75050 ship: offset cockpit, three unequal wings, four-nozzle cluster; retained in supplied static pose.

sections.name: study-773704369559-01-75050---B-Wing.ldr
sections.description: Large angular B-Wing starfighter featuring inverted slopes, wedge plates, grille detailing, and a technic-brick and pin framework for the folding wing structure.
sections.visual_observation: Single detailed airframe section contains the ship geometry. Root merely places it; metadata must not invent separately stored wing, fuselage and engine submodels.

sections.name: study-81a8902a5014-00-6887---Spaceship---Cockpit.ldr
sections.description: Spaceship - Cockpit
sections.visual_observation: Octagonal transparent side halves enclose seated pilot; hinged central glazing closes top/front. Actual parent places cockpit forward of craft. Correct rear-glazing wording.

sections.name: study-81a8902a5014-01-6887---Spaceship---Cockpit---Door.ldr
sections.description: Spaceship - Cockpit - Door
sections.visual_observation: Hinged central canopy closure has transparent shaped panel, cone pair and inward tool-holder detail. Extra right/back context views confirm top/front location, not a rear window.

sections.name: study-81a8902a5014-02-6887---Minifig.ldr
sections.description: Minifig
sections.visual_observation: Seated helmeted pilot with raised visor is inside the cockpit; retained as occupant-envelope context, not independent vehicle structure.

sections.name: study-81a8902a5014-03-6887---Minifig---Helmet.ldr
sections.description: Minifig - Helmet
sections.visual_observation: Black helmet and green raised visor; inspected alone and on pilot.

manual_parents.description: LEGO Star Wars Ultimate Collector Series Millennium Falcon (set 10179): a large light-bluish-grey Corellian freighter with a round saucer hull, offset cockpit with connecting corridor, twin forward cargo mandibles and a side docking ring, a top-mounted rotating rectenna sensor dish, four quad laser cannon turrets (two dorsal, two ventral), a ventral boarding ramp and four retractable landing legs, a rear bank of engine nozzles, and a detailed interior (holochess table, bunks and smuggling compartments), plus five minifigures - Han Solo, Chewbacca, Princess Leia, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker

sections.name: study-433ddd068200-00-10179---subModel-43.ldr
sections.description: Upper hull greeble cluster (right): wing panel, domes, control sticks, loudhailer and antenna
sections.visual_observation: Small right-upper-hull wedge plate carries domed/control-stick, loudhailer and antenna details; parent places it in a localized service bay. Do not inherit unsupported whole-parent prose.

manual_parents.description: Starboard lower wing panel built from angled wing plates, long white plates, and red-tinted detail tiles with stripe accents.
Port upper wing surface built from angled left-wing plates, long white plates, and red stripe detail tiles.

sections.name: study-d883cdec86c9-00-7191---nacelle-2.ldr
sections.description: Cylindrical engine nacelle using Technic cylinders, round red bricks, and axle-connected structural components.
sections.visual_observation: Long concentric cylindrical engine with red inner round elements, rear nozzle and transverse mounting features. Both original wing-parent placements inspected. This nacelle-2 differs in mounting details from wing package nacelle-1.

manual_parents.description: A small detail submodel containing a single light grey 2x2 dish with rim, likely a decorative sensor or cockpit element.

sections.name: study-7f62aaf2edbb-00-7191---bottom-port-wing.ldr
sections.description: The lower port X-wing wing assembly built from wing panels, long plates, and grooved tiles forming the layered attack-wing surface.
sections.visual_observation: Thin wedge plate wing with root nacelle and long tip cannon; actual parent is whole X-wing airframe, contradicting metadata calling it a single dish.

sections.name: study-7f62aaf2edbb-01-7191---blaster.ldr
sections.description: A large detailed blaster cannon or mechanical greeble assembly built from round bricks, cylinders, gears, axles, a ribbed hose, and an antenna.
sections.visual_observation: Long axial tip cannon with cylinder base, gear/ribbed region and projecting bar; parent view establishes tip position.

sections.name: study-7f62aaf2edbb-02-7191---nacelle-1.ldr
sections.description: A laser cannon engine nacelle assembly built from Technic cylinders, round bricks, axle-mounted gears, and grille bricks forming the cylindrical engine pod.
sections.visual_observation: Nacelle-1 engine with round red inlet core, cylindrical body and slender exhaust; distinguish engine from separate tip laser and from nacelle-2 mount variant.

sections.name: study-7f62aaf2edbb-03-7191---wing-step13-2.ldr
sections.description: Small wing sub-assembly with a mounting bracket, white plates, black grille tiles, and round light grey accent plates.
sections.visual_observation: Small root trim/support strip of plates, grilles and a perpendicular mount; inspected at inner wing near nacelle.

manual_parents.description: Starboard engine nacelle subassembly of the Y-Wing with no direct pieces listed.

sections.name: study-82f029a5d28a-00-75181---Y-Wing-Starfighter---step254-261.ldr
sections.description: Angled hull armor panel built from plates, slope bricks, raised grille plates, and a hinge tile forming a contoured body panel with greebled detailing.
sections.visual_observation: Long rectangular plate-backed panel with straight sloped borders, grille sections and central flex hose detail; mounted on starboard engine nacelle. Correct guide references to wedge plates and curved surface.

sections.name: study-f3acc2a54bd6-00-75055---Main.ldr
sections.description: Assembly of a large wedge-shaped Imperial Star Destroyer built from layered grey plates, angled wing sections, and click-lock hinge mechanisms.
sections.visual_observation: Broad triangular ship with recessed side band, layered superstructure and raised bridge; shape inspiration only, existing 416 non-rigid-transform and 39 overlap errors remain.

sections.name: study-f3acc2a54bd6-01-75055---Imperial-Star-Destroyer.ldr
sections.description: Large wedge-shaped grey starship hull constructed from hundreds of plates, tiles, and angled left-wing sections forming the iconic triangular silhouette.
sections.visual_observation: Main detailed ship section reproduces same whole hull; underside reveals plate/hinge construction but no independent small structural modules. Retain only with whole inspiration package.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-00-10134---main.ldr
sections.description: LEGO Star Wars Ultimate Collector Series Y-wing Attack Starfighter (set 10134-1): a Rebel starfighter with a long central fuselage, a tinted bubble cockpit with twin nose laser cannons and an R5-D4 astromech droid, two large ribbed engine nacelles on outrigger struts, and a dorsal sensor/ion-cannon turret, presented on a black display stand with a tiled info plaque
sections.visual_observation: Whole ship has a narrow detailed spine, long twin nacelles and rear strut cages, white/yellow forward shell and black display stand. Inspiration only; 37 recorded overlaps remain. Tapered canopy is not a bubble enclosure.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-01-10134---subModel-1.ldr
sections.description: Curved hull side panel built from inverted curved slopes, wedges and grooved tiles
sections.visual_observation: Flat tiled hull cheek with shaped underside sits beside forward cockpit; preserve model-local orientation.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-02-10134---subModel-2.ldr
sections.description: Small bracket mounting block with a round reinforced stud
sections.visual_observation: Small bracket/plate mounting block with round element sits toward aft central machinery; no strength inference.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-03-10134---subModel-3.ldr
sections.description: Small swivel/sensor mount with a rounded cap on a technic-pin base
sections.visual_observation: Two Technic bricks with pins carry round cylinder and minifig-head shaped detail on central spine. Do not claim a working swivel or sensor from the decorative shape.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-04-10134---subModel-4.ldr
sections.description: Flat hull strip rail with studs on the side
sections.visual_observation: Three-part rail presents four sideways studs; two parent instances sit in aft central machinery.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-05-10134---subModel-5.ldr
sections.description: Small grip detail: headlight bricks capped with a handled tile
sections.visual_observation: Two headlight bricks carry handled tile; parent repeats this handle detail on opposite sides of spine.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-06-10134---subModel-6.ldr
sections.description: Clip attachment point: headlight brick with a clip tile
sections.visual_observation: Headlight brick plus clip tile; four instances around central spine. Retain as dependency with no new connectivity certification.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-07-10134---subModel-7.ldr
sections.description: Wing panel section with a round grille/vent detail tile
sections.visual_observation: Two-piece wing-shaped plate and printed round grille detail, repeated on aft central spine; not a complete wing assembly.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-09-10134---subModel-R5-D4.ldr
sections.description: R5-D4 astromech droid: patterned cylindrical body, domed head and two legs
sections.visual_observation: Patterned white/red astromech body, rounded head and two legs; seated behind cockpit in the main body. Preserve source identity rather than using it as a generic mechanism.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-10-10134---subModel-8.ldr
sections.description: Port engine nacelle rear section: exhaust grilles, copper hoses and control sticks
sections.visual_observation: Detailed rectangular outrigger between central fuselage and one engine, with copper-coloured hoses, pins and side-stud faces. Source description incorrectly calls this a rear engine nacelle.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-11-10134---subModel-9.ldr
sections.description: Starboard engine nacelle rear section: exhaust grilles, copper hoses and control sticks
sections.visual_observation: Opposite outrigger with similar hose/grille detailing and different handed layout. Source description incorrectly calls this a rear engine nacelle.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-12-10134---subModel-10.ldr
sections.description: Long hull/strut assembly with angled inverted-slope cheeks, ventral detail, a sensor dome and an antenna mast
sections.visual_observation: Main rectangular engine body with long surface hoses, side panels and conical rear nozzle; two instances in whole ship. Correct generic hull/strut and sensor-mast wording.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-13-10134---subModel-11.ldr
sections.description: Short axle-and-bush spacer/connector sub-assembly
sections.visual_observation: Short transverse axle through paired Technic bricks with bushes; four placements on engine body provide lateral attachment features.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-14-10134---subModel-12.ldr
sections.description: Dorsal rotating sensor/weapon dome turret with mechanical arms, a cone and a trans-neon dish
sections.visual_observation: Conical engine nozzle and surrounding clips/arms mounted at rear of engine body. Source description falsely calls it a dorsal rotating sensor/weapon turret.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-15-10134---subModel-13.ldr
sections.description: Antenna/sensor mast array with a lance mast, grilles and clip plates
sections.visual_observation: Long thin engine-side surface strip with lance-shaped pipe and grille tiles, repeated on opposite engine-body faces. Not an upright antenna mast array.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-16-10134---subModel-14.ldr
sections.description: Vented side hull panel with grille tiles and pin mounts
sections.visual_observation: Thin vented strip with underside pins and central handled detail, placed on outer engine sides; scope label to nacelle trim.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-17-10134---subModel-15.ldr
sections.description: Engine nacelle front: spoked wheel-cowling, domed hub and ribbed armour runs
sections.visual_observation: Long open rear engine cage: four ribbed struts terminate in a round wheel-like end ring. Two instances extend aft from nacelles. Source incorrectly calls it engine front/cowling.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-18-10134---subModel-16.ldr
sections.description: Engine axle/connector linkage with angle connectors and notched axles
sections.visual_observation: Paired transverse axle/angle-connector brace located at the cage end ring. Static geometry does not establish moving linkage behavior.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-19-10134---subModel-17.ldr
sections.description: Small axle-and-bush connector sub-assembly
sections.visual_observation: Axle and paired angle connectors with bushes, nested as one crosspiece of end-ring brace.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-20-10134---subModel-18.ldr
sections.description: Engine nacelle ribbed armour/hose run on a long axle
sections.visual_observation: Long ribbed strut assembled along an axle line; four copies form the cage. Clarify rear cage strut rather than armour/hose run.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-21-10134---subModel-20.ldr
sections.description: Domed housing section with a hinged panel and four side strut/appendage assemblies
sections.visual_observation: Rounded white forward nacelle housing with yellow stripe, internal core and four decorative side struts; two instances at forward engine ends.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-22-10134---subModel-19.ldr
sections.description: Hinged access panel section with inverted slopes, handles and grilles
sections.visual_observation: Substantial box-shaped core inside forward nacelle housing, with pin interfaces, side studs, handles and hinged faces. Not merely a hinged access panel.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-23-10134---subModel-21.ldr
sections.description: Small mechanical strut/appendage: bracket, curved bar arm and mechanical torso
sections.visual_observation: Two-rod decorative side strut with mechanical-figure pieces at one end; four copies wrap forward nacelle housing. No functional actuator claim.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-24-10134---subModel-22.ldr
sections.description: Cockpit and forward fuselage: tinted trans-brown canopy, turntable mount and nose-cannon mount
sections.visual_observation: White/yellow forward hull and tapered tinted cockpit canopy, side cheek strips, nose projections and raised dorsal twin cannon. Retain as part of inspiration package pending repairs.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-25-10134---subModel-23.ldr
sections.description: Small angled hull strip with a curved slope and yellow trim
sections.visual_observation: Slim curved/sloped white/yellow cheek rail, repeated along both cockpit sides with local frame transformed into parent.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-26-10134---subModel-24.ldr
sections.description: Small hinged detail/barrel sub-assembly with a thin rod and locking hinge
sections.visual_observation: Small plate-and-locking-hinge construction at rear edge of canopy; describe canopy mounting/hinge support rather than a barrel.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-27-10134---subModel-25.ldr
sections.description: Twin nose cannon/antenna array: cones on long bars with tap mounts
sections.visual_observation: Paired bar-and-cone cannon detail on roof behind canopy. Source calls it twin nose cannon/antenna, but parent proves dorsal position.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-28-10134---subModel-26.ldr
sections.description: Black display stand/base structure with model cradles, supports and plaque mount
sections.visual_observation: Complete black display stand with crossed feet, tall Technic upright, diagonal brace and angled blank tiled plaque. Stability remains unproven.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-29-10134---subModel-27.ldr
sections.description: Display stand support arm/cradle of technic bricks and pins
sections.visual_observation: Tall Technic-brick upright placed vertically in stand; top pins form model-support region.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-30-10134---subModel-28.ldr
sections.description: Technic support bracket/linkage for the display stand
sections.visual_observation: Bent liftarm brace connects low portion of upright to stand base; static bracing, no demonstrated mechanism.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-31-10134---subModel-29.ldr
sections.description: Small angled technic liftarm joint
sections.visual_observation: Paired short angled liftarms and axle form nested top joint of stand brace.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-32-10134---subModel-30.ldr
sections.description: Hinged mounting cradle/support that holds the model on the stand
sections.visual_observation: Small hinged plates appear twice at plaque location on stand base. Correct metadata claiming these directly hold the model: they support the plaque.

sections.name: study-4de7854b1628-33-10134---subModel-31.ldr
sections.description: Display stand info plaque/nameplate base with a tiled top
sections.visual_observation: Broad black tiled plaque panel on front of stand. No printed information is present in this source; label blank plaque surface.
